hip_chosen_of_6_correction: MISLEADING KEY NAME, corrected r227 by annotation rather than by changing the value. hip_chosen_of_6 counts folds in which 'hip_flexion_LmR' was selected, and that is 0. But all six folds selected 'hip_flexion_r' (see channel_per_fold), which is ALSO a hip channel -- the right-limb hip flexion ROM, of which hip_flexion_LmR is a difference. Read as written the key says no hip channel was chosen; the truth is that a hip channel was chosen in 6 of 6 folds and it was not the asymmetry construction. The value is unchanged; the name is the defect.
